newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude could test support at $19.40.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude could test support at $19.40.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
----------------- VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - April 16 ------------
+ NYMEX crude faced a volatile day as the market assessed overnight damage and whether the recent correction had failed.
+ Key support for the contract seen at $19.35/45 and resistance at $20.07/10.
+ Gasoline falters,.upport at 60.75 and resistance at 62.10/50
NYMEX crude futures faced an unsettled session on Wednesday as the market waited to see whether overnight falls signalled the end of the recent upward correction, chartists said.
May crude closed seven cents lower at $19.83 a barrel and last traded 28 cents lower at $19.55 on ACCESS.
Scott Siller at MCM in New York said that although the market appeared supported by the double bottom at $18.96 on April 4 and 10 there were signs of waning.
Siller pegged key support for May around $19.40, the equivalent to a 62 pct retracement of the $18.96-20.09 move.
"Anyone who wants to give the upside one last chance could try buying around the $19.50 area, with stops at about $19.40/35," he said.

Charles Gray at Prudential Bache in London said there was a possibility crude could stage one of its classic post American Petroleum Institute reversals. He pegged resistance at $20.10 and support at $19.35/45 and $18.96.
Siller saw resistance $20.07 in line with Tuesday's high.
Some chartists said a close above $20 would be a positive sign -- the June contract has not closed above there since April 2.
Gasoline's fortunes looked similarly up in the air.
The May contract closed a 0.06 cent off at 61.90 cents a gallon and last traded a 0.92 cent off at 60.55 cents.
"Only a move above 62.30/50 cents gives us a real green light for unleaded," said Gray in his daily energy report.
Analysts at MeesPierson Derivatives saw resistance for gasoline around 62.10, 63.30 and 64.20 cents and support at 61.35, 60.75 and 59.55 cents.
Heating oil, meanwhile, looked set to range trade with MeesPierson pegging resistance at 54.90, 55.20 and 56.50 cents and support at 54.20, 53.70 and 52.70 cents.
Heat closed a 0.18 cent higher at 54.85 a gallon, but last traded a 0.80 cent lower at 54.05 cents a gallon. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714.
